## No circles behind symbols
- Symbols (repeat, shuffle, queue, devices, heart, + and all other icon buttons) no longer get a round background or ring when you hover, press or click them, in every theme and on every device. Only the colour changes, an active button keeps its small dot
- The focus ring only shows when you use the keyboard, not after a click or tap

## Install
- **Update server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script)
- **Apps:** nothing to install, the change comes from the server
